# Smooth Birth Apothecary
> Traditional East Asian herbal tinctures formulated by licensed acupuncturist and certified herbalist Simba Eun-Hye Shim, L.Ac.

## Overview
Smooth Birth Apothecary (`https://smoothbirth.com/`) offers targeted, clinical-grade botanical tinctures supporting pregnant and birthing families across four key clinical phases:
1. Pregnancy Support (Swell Away, Deep Rest 1, Deep Rest 2, Cool Center)
2. Birth Prep (Getting Ready, Boost Up)
3. Labor Support (More Oomph, High Baby, Turn Around)
4. Postpartum Recovery (Abundant Flow)

## Founder & Clinical Lineage
- [Meet the Founder](https://smoothbirth.com/about.html): Simba Eun-Hye Shim, L.Ac. is a licensed acupuncturist and certified East Asian herbalist (Master of Acupuncture & CHM, Southwest Acupuncture College) practicing at Boulder Birth and Holistic Health since 2021. Formulations are rooted in classical East Asian medical texts and developed in active collaboration with midwives and doulas.

## Product Catalog & Dedicated Formula Pages

### Phase 1: Pregnancy Support
- [Swell Away](https://smoothbirth.com/swell-away.html): 2 fl oz. Formulated for prenatal edema, fluid retention, polyhydramnios, and pregnancy-induced carpal tunnel syndrome. Powered by Fu Ling, American Ginseng, and Sang Zhi.
- [Deep Rest 1](https://smoothbirth.com/deep-rest-1.html): 2 fl oz. Nourishing nervous system tonic for prenatal sleep support, insomnia, systemic tension, and nighttime restlessness.
- [Deep Rest 2](https://smoothbirth.com/deep-rest-2.html): 2 fl oz. Calming botanical support for late-pregnancy insomnia accompanied by internal heat, night sweats, irritability, and vivid dreaming.
- [Cool Center](https://smoothbirth.com/cool-center.html): 1 fl oz. Rapid relief for pregnancy heartburn, acid reflux, epigastric heat, and sour regurgitation.

### Phase 2: Birth Prep (36+ Weeks)
- [Getting Ready](https://smoothbirth.com/getting-ready.html): 1 fl oz. Cervical ripening, pelvic tissue relaxation, and birth prep starting at 37-39 weeks to encourage smooth spontaneous labor onset.
- [Boost Up](https://smoothbirth.com/boost-up.html): 1 fl oz. Maternal stamina and vital energy tonic to prevent physical exhaustion before and during the early phases of labor.

### Phase 3: Active Labor Support
- [More Oomph](https://smoothbirth.com/more-oomph.html): 2 fl oz. Bedside contraction catalyst for slow, irregular, stalled, or tiring labor progress. Helps coordinate rhythmic uterine surges.
- [High Baby](https://smoothbirth.com/high-baby.html): 2 fl oz. Downward-directing botanical catalyst for high fetal station, encouraging pelvic opening and engagement.
- [Turn Around](https://smoothbirth.com/turn-around.html): 2 fl oz. Pelvic relaxation and rotational support for occiput posterior (OP) "sunny-side up" or persistent fetal malpositions.

### Phase 4: Postpartum Recovery
- [Abundant Flow](https://smoothbirth.com/abundant-flow.html): 2 fl oz. Deep Fourth Trimester replenishment supporting maternal blood, robust lactation, milk supply, and energy recovery following birth.

## B2B Wholesale Portal for Birth Professionals
- [Wholesale Portal](https://smoothbirth.com/wholesale.html): Direct wholesale ordering for licensed midwives (CNM, CPM), doulas, birth centers, and obstetric clinics. Features live batch minimum calculations (8 oz batch minimums: 8 bottles for 1 oz / 4 bottles for 2 oz), free direct shipping on orders over $250, and Clerk BaaS practitioner authentication.
